# Amazon Listing Optimization: Your Complete Guide To Driving More Sales

A practical guide to Amazon listing optimization: titles, bullets, images and keywords that lift conversions and cut returns, plus managing it in a PIM.

![Amazon Listing Optimization: Your Complete Guide To Driving More Sales](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/e1brcdny/production/c341e996af66d633e005bc74892c63abc948731e-1024x768.png?w=960&q=80&auto=format)

Many sellers obsess over the Amazon A9 algorithm (or is it A10?). The algorithm's specifics are largely unknown, but Amazon's primary goal is clear: to provide customers with a positive buying experience that minimizes returns.

Focusing on these three drivers of success is far more effective, regardless of the platform:

*   Relevance: Does your product match the customer's search query?
*   Sales Performance: Are customers buying your product?
*   Conversion Rates: Are visitors turning into buyers?

### Keywords: The Foundation of Discoverability

Keywords are the breadcrumbs that lead customers to your product. Specificity is key. Instead of "blue sweater," use "Cashmere crewneck sweater, women's size medium, navy blue."

WISEPIM helps you build comprehensive product data, going beyond simple keywords:

Vague product data next to the specific version shoppers search for

| Detail | Specific | Instead of |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Material | "100% organic long-staple cotton" | "cotton" |
| Features | "Two side pockets, one internal zippered pocket" | "pockets" |
| Style | "Relaxed fit, perfect for layering" | "casual" |
| Size | Waist size in inches, length and other precise measurements |     |

Every specific value is something a shopper could type into the search bar.

Detailed, accurate product information attracts the_right_customers.

### Sales Performance: Popularity Matters

Higher sales lead to increased visibility. Amazon favors proven winners.

Boosting sales requires more than just ads. Exceptional product information is crucial.

Consider two identical toaster listings. One has a blurry photo and a minimal description: "Toaster. Works." The other features multiple high-quality images, a detailed description highlighting its bagel-toasting and cool-touch features, and a video demonstration. Which would you choose?

WISEPIM helps you create compelling listings that emphasize quality and value.

### Conversion Rates: Turning Clicks into Sales

Clicks are important, but conversions are the ultimate goal. Your**Listing Quality Score (LQS)**is like a report card for your product listing. Amazon doesn't disclose all the criteria, but it's known to include:

*   Keyword Relevance
*   Compelling Titles and Descriptions
*   Positive Reviews
*   High-Quality Images

WISEPIM helps you improve your LQS by ensuring your product data is complete, accurate, and optimized.

### Beyond A9/A10: Focus on BSR (Best Seller Rank)

The **Best Seller Rank (BSR)**is a transparent and useful metric. It's a popularity score within a product category. A lower number is better, with #1 being the top seller.

BSR is updated hourly and is influenced by:

*   Recent Sales: Higher sales improve BSR.
*   Historical Sales: Consistent performance builds a strong foundation.
*   Price and Promotions: Competitive pricing and promotions offer a boost.

While BSR doesn't directly impact organic search ranking, it earns you the "Best Seller" badge, attracting customers. Best-selling products are also often featured in curated lists, further increasing visibility.

## The 6 Pillars of Optimized Product Listings

Let's build a strong product listing, focusing on the fundamentals.

Loading diagram

### 1\. Keyword Research: Go Beyond the Obvious

Keyword research is about understanding your customers' language.

*   Amazon's Autocomplete: Type your product name into the Amazon search bar and observe the suggestions. These are actual customer searches.
*   Competitor Analysis: Examine your competitors' listings for keyword inspiration. Use WISEPIM's attribute suggestions to discover even better terms.
*   Think Beyond Amazon:Use other tools to identify high-volume keywords that may not be showing up in your amazon research.

### 2\. Product Title: Create a Captivating Headline

Your product title is your first impression. It must be clear, concise, and informative.

Amazon recommends titles under 60 characters, but the character limit is higher. Clarity is paramount. A good structure is:

**\[Brand\] + \[Model/Series\] + \[Product Type\] + \[Key Features/Benefits\] + \[Size/Color/Quantity\]**

> Example: "WISEPIM Premium - Memory Foam Dog Bed - Orthopedic, Washable Cover - Large, Gray (2-Pack)"

### 3\. Images: Show, Don't Just Tell

High-quality images are essential. Use multiple angles and ensure they are well-lit.

Amazon allows up to 9 images (or 8 and a video). Use them all.

**Image Guidelines:**

Amazon product image checklist

Copy

0 of 7 done0%

*   Between 500px and 10,000px on the longest side
*   JPEG, TIFF, PNG or non-animated GIF
*   Sharp, with no blur
*   Pure white background on the main imageRGB 255, 255, 255
*   Product fills at least 85% of the image
*   No text, logos, watermarks or props that aren't included with the purchase
*   Every side of the product is shown across the image set

Check every image against these seven points before you upload it.

### 4\. Bullet Points: Highlight Features and Benefits

Bullet points provide concise sales pitches for your product's key attributes.

*   Focus on Benefits: Explain why a feature matters. ("Durable stainless steel construction resists rust and corrosion" instead of just "Made of stainless steel").
*   Address Objections: Anticipate and address concerns. ("Dishwasher safe for easy cleaning").
*   Use Keywords: Incorporate keywords naturally.
*   Be Concise: Keep bullet points short and scannable.

### 5\. Product Description: Tell Your Product's Story

The product description expands on bullet points and provides a more complete narrative.

*   Expand on Features: Offer more detail about key features and benefits.
*   Use Cases: Describe real-life scenarios where the product is useful.
*   Include Additional Information: Add care instructions, warranty details, etc.
*   Be Engaging: Use a conversational tone and write for your target audience.

### 6\. Ratings and Reviews: Leverage Social Proof

Positive reviews build trust and credibility.

*   Request Reviews: Amazon sends automatic review requests, but you can also send a one-time request from your orders page.
*   Provide Excellent Customer Service: Go the extra mile for customer satisfaction.
*   Respond to Reviews: Engage with both positive and negative reviews professionally.

# Product Listing Optimization: How To Get Your Products Seen

If your products rank for relevant searches on Google Shopping, Amazon, and your own ecommerce store, you can make more sales.

![](https://www.gravatar.com/avatar/d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e?s=200&d=404)

by Shopify StaffJan 17, 2025 • 9 min read

![Display of cosmetics on a monochromatic tan background: product listing optimization.](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0070/7032/files/product_20marketing_1848x970.png?v=1721020281&originalWidth=1848&originalHeight=782)

Shoppers love to compare options. Whether they're browsing directly on your website or on a third-party channel like Google Shopping or Amazon (where [36%](https://www.statista.com/statistics/1034209/global-product-search-online-sources/) of all product searches start), you have mere seconds to stand out to customers. This makes your product listings crucial.

Luckily, with product listing optimization, you can shape how your products appear in these critical moments. Learn to improve your product listings to reap the benefits for your business.

## What is a product listing?

A product listing is a card or tile showcasing an ecommerce product and its key features. They most often appear alongside other comparable products. They can live on your website, such as on your collection pages, on third-party sites like the Amazon marketplace, or in search results like the [Google Shopping](https://www.shopify.com/enterprise/blog/the-master-guide-to-google-shopping) ads at the top of the search engine results page for products.

These listings aim to help people decide which product is right for them by showcasing key product details like:

*   Name
*   Image
*   Price
*   Promotional offers
*   Brand

As a marketer, when creating your product listings, it's helpful to include as much information as you can to help online shoppers make informed decisions. For example, feature positive ratings, whether you offer free delivery, and any unique features or specifications that can help you stand out.

## What is product listing optimization?

Product listing optimization is the process of improving your product listings to increase their visibility and attractiveness to shoppers. When you optimize your product listings, they help increase click-through rates and drive more sales.

Product listings draw information from product pages via feeds. To optimize your product listings, regularly [update your product detail pages](https://www.shopify.com/blog/expert-advice-improve-product-pages#5) and [learn to manage your store admin](https://www.shopifyacademy.com/shopify-admin-guided-tour) and the info stored on those pages.

There are two main objectives to keep in mind. First, provide buyers with information that helps them understand which product best suits their needs. Second, consider the needs of search engines and third-party platform algorithms to ensure inclusion in search results. This means identifying the right keywords, incorporating high-quality images, and updating all relevant back-end fields. Once you've hit the right chord, continue to iterate and adapt over time.

## 8 ways to optimize your ecommerce product listing

1.  [Tailor your listing to the channel](https://www.shopify.com/blog/product-listing-optimization#111)
2.  [Use high-impact product images](https://www.shopify.com/blog/product-listing-optimization#222)
3.  [Find the most relevant keywords](https://www.shopify.com/blog/product-listing-optimization#333)
4.  [Write a descriptive and accurate product title](https://www.shopify.com/blog/product-listing-optimization#444)
5.  [Aim for positive reviews](https://www.shopify.com/blog/product-listing-optimization#555)
6.  [Test your listing elements](https://www.shopify.com/blog/product-listing-optimization#666)
7.  [Highlight promotions and discounts](https://www.shopify.com/blog/product-listing-optimization#777)
8.  [Use structured data](https://www.shopify.com/blog/product-listing-optimization#888)

Product listing optimization requires creativity and technical knowledge. Here are seven tactics to punch up your product listings to drive sales and increase visibility.

### 1\. Tailor your listing to the channel

Product listings can appear on first-party channels, like a collection page on your website, or alongside your competition on third-party channels, like Amazon's marketplace.

Each third-party channel has its own nuances and specifications for structuring product listings and data. Tailor your content to each channel's guidelines to ensure your products rank among their search results. For example, the requirements for [Google Merchant Center](
